text: BAM share rose 0.15 percentage points over 23 hours and 0.14 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.8%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.1% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 58 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not evidence of a structural rollover.
